#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
W="$HOME/work/rollout-experiments-20261114"
export STU_RUNTIME="$W/runtime" STU_EXPERIMENT_OUT="$W/runs"
export STU_PYTHON="$HOME/work/loop/venv/bin/python" SURE_BIN="$HOME/work/loop/bin/sure_cpp"
export BRIDGE_NET_BF16=1
for attempt in $(seq 1 80); do
  if [ -f "$W/drain-status.json" ] && "$STU_PYTHON" -c 'import json,sys;sys.exit(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["status"]!="drained")' "$W/drain-status.json" && ! systemctl is-active --quiet loop-collect; then
    break
  fi
  if [ "$attempt" = 80 ]; then echo 'Drain not complete; experiments not launched'; exit 1; fi
  sleep 15
done
"$STU_PYTHON" - "$W" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,time
w=Path(sys.argv[1]); r=w/'runtime'
files=['bridge_harness/x8_player.py','bridge_harness/x8_rollout.py','bridge_harness/gen7.py','bridge_harness/libbridge_dds.so','models/cardplay/stu-net-r4c-20261113/policy.npz']
p=dict(started=time.strftime('%FT%TZ',time.gmtime()),runtime=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(r),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),implementation=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(w/'code'),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),bf16=True,seed=2026111401,training_excluded=True,files={f:hashlib.sha256((r/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files})
(w/'runs/provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2))
PY
export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 BRIDGE_DDS_CACHE=''
HERE="$W/code/scripts/stu_rollout_experiments"
"$STU_PYTHON" "$HERE/make_config.py" --bots "$STU_RUNTIME/configs/loop-bots.json" --out "$W/runs/bots.json"
"$STU_PYTHON" - "$W/runs/bots.json" <<'PY'
import copy,json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]; b=json.load(open(p))
b['rx-sham']=copy.deepcopy(b['rx-control'])
b['rx-reader-guarantee']=copy.deepcopy(b['rx-reader'])
b['rx-reader-guarantee']['x8']['claims']['opponents']=['*']
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(b,indent=2))
PY
for variant in sham reader guarantee reader-guarantee; do
  if [ "$variant" = sham ]; then count=32; first=3000; else count=512; first=4000; fi
  run="$W/runs/mechanism-$variant"
  "$STU_PYTHON" "$HERE/match.py" --source "$HOME/work/loop/capsule/recovery" --bots "$W/runs/bots.json" --pair "rx-$variant~rx-control" --seed 2026111401 --first "$first" --deals "$count" --workers 8 --recycle 8 --common-only --episodes --out "$run" > "$W/runs/mechanism-$variant.log" 2>&1
  "$STU_PYTHON" - "$run" "$count" <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,sys
s=json.loads((pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])/'summary.json').read_text())
assert s['boards']==int(sys.argv[2]) and not s.get('failures',0), s
print(json.dumps(s),flush=True)
PY
  "$STU_PYTHON" "$HERE/summarize.py" "$W/runs"
done
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$W/runs/FINISHED"
